description: Returns the direct purchase link for Rotate Pilot's prep for an exam (Stripe Checkout on rotatepilot.com), or the plans page when that exam has no one-click checkout. It does not charge anything: the user completes payment in their browser.

exam.description: FAA knowledge test: part107 (drone / Remote Pilot, UAG), ppl (Private Pilot Airplane, PAR), ifr (Instrument Rating Airplane, IRA), cpl (Commercial Pilot Airplane, CAX), atp (Airline Transport Pilot Multiengine, ATM).
